_comment: Ceilings for the context budget, checked by scripts/context_budget.py --check (CI job lint). Policy: ceiling = observed value + ~5% headroom, so CI catches regressions without flagging noise. After a deliberate slimming, tighten to the new observed values + ~5%; raise a ceiling only together with the change that justifies the growth. Values are BYTES; the script converts them to calibrated cl100k estimates for the report (see BYTES_PER_TOKEN there). body_bytes is the per-invocation cost of skill bodies - an order of magnitude above the startup surface, which is why it is gated rather than left unmeasured. Current values: python3 scripts/context_budget.py.
